answer: The premise appears to be incorrect. In the LINE paper (Tang et al., 2015), LINE(1st) alone does not give the best Wikipedia classification result. It performs worse than LINE(2nd) alone. The best result comes from concatenating the separately trained first-order and second-order embeddings, LINE(1st+2nd). The gain comes from combining the two proximity orders, not from LINE(1st) by itself.
